cues.en: This is a 32 inch e ink display.
cues.zh: 这是一个 32 英寸的电子墨水屏。

cues.en: It's silent, wireless, and can run for months without being recharged.
cues.zh: 它运行时没有声音，无需连接线缆，而且几个月都不用充电。

cues.en: It can display art,
cues.zh: 它可以展示艺术作品、

cues.en: images,
cues.zh: 图像，

cues.en: or other information, but most of the time, I have it rotating through the front pages of newspapers from around the country. Newspapers for me and for many others have become largely intangible. We get our news from mobile devices and web pages. We don't really touch them or hold them in the same way nor are they really dynamic.
cues.zh: 或者其他信息。不过大多数时候，我会让它轮播全国各地报纸的头版。对我和许多人来说，报纸已经变得大多无法触及。我们通过移动设备和网页获取新闻，既不像以前那样真正触摸或拿在手里，内容也谈不上实时变化。

cues.en: Most web pages, most mobile apps are based on templatized
cues.zh: 绝大多数网页和移动应用都基于模板化的

cues.en: content management systems, and so the unique design that goes into each newspaper
cues.zh: 内容管理系统，因此每份报纸原有的独特设计

cues.en: really isn't there. I wanted to be reminded of both the diversity of news, the journalism that goes on around the clock, and the design elements that go into a well designed newspaper.
cues.zh: 其实荡然无存。我希望能重新体会到新闻的多元性、全天候运作的新闻报道，以及一份排版精良的报纸背后蕴含的设计元素。

cues.en: E ink technology is most commonly found in digital book products like the Kindle. The same technology is powering this display. This particular display is a Vision Egg 32 inch place and play display.
cues.zh: 电子墨水技术最常见于 Kindle 等电子书产品中。这块屏幕采用的也是这项技术。这块具体的屏幕是 Visionect 32 英寸的即插即用显示屏。

cues.en: The unit is a little bit pricey. It retails for $2,500.
cues.zh: 这台设备有点贵，零售价2500美元。

cues.en: It's expensive, but well engineered. It has brushed aluminum casings and a glass pane to prevent scratching and hazing.
cues.zh: 虽贵但工艺精良，采用拉丝铝外壳和玻璃面板，防刮防雾。

cues.en: The price is driven largely by the low number of units that are actually produced in... Out in the world. These units are really designed for museums, airports, and other installations,
cues.zh: 价格高昂主要是因为实际产量很低……全球范围内产量有限。这些设备主要面向博物馆、机场等场所的装置，

cues.en: and that's unfortunate because the display is really fantastic.
cues.zh: 这很可惜，因为显示屏确实非常出色。

cues.en: The unit is initially set up and added to WiFi and charged via USB cable, but once the initial setup is complete, you really don't touch it at all. The unit has no user interface, no touchable buttons, no controls, nothing to fiddle with. Once the unit is up and running, you're really just enjoying the content that is being displayed on the device. While the unit is fantastic and very consumer friendly from the display portion,
cues.zh: 这台设备最初需要完成设置、连接 WiFi，并通过 USB 线充电。不过初始设置完成后，基本上就不用再碰它了。设备没有用户界面，没有可触碰的按钮，也没有任何控制装置，没什么需要摆弄的。设备运行起来后，你只需欣赏它显示的内容。它的显示部分很出色，也非常适合普通消费者使用，

cues.en: getting it set up and connected to the server and technical components is a little more tedious and complicated.
cues.zh: 但要完成设置、连接服务器和配置技术组件，过程就稍微繁琐复杂一些。

cues.en: So it's not really designed to be a consumer oriented product,
cues.zh: 所以它并不是一款真正面向消费者的产品，

cues.en: which is a shame because I think the technology is really applicable and really exciting to have in the home. The software needed to run the unit is broken up into two parts. The first part is the server component,
cues.zh: 这挺可惜的，因为我觉得这项技术非常适合家用，放在家里也很酷。运行这台设备所需的软件分为两部分。第一部分是服务端组件，

cues.en: and that server component connects to the display and allows it to render the images, web pages from the Internet, photo galleries, and other content. This is set up via what's called a Docker container and I was able to get it on my home server. Now not everyone has a home server, so again this may not be for everyone. The second part is the application server which I wrote, which connects to the internet and downloads
cues.zh: 该服务端组件连接到显示屏，负责渲染图像、来自互联网的网页、相册以及其他内容。这是通过所谓的 Docker 容器部署的，我把它跑在了我的家用服务器上。不过不是每个人都有家用服务器，所以这也未必适合所有人。第二部分是我编写的应用服务器，它连接到互联网并下载

cues.en: front pages of the internet from online public sources. Some of the sources I'm using include Freedom Forum, which is a nonprofit that works on first amendment freedoms
cues.zh: 来自公开网络来源的头版内容。我使用的一些数据源包括 Freedom Forum，这是一个致力于第一修正案自由权利的非营利组织

cues.en: and first amendment rights, which is the freedom of the press. The newspaper portion runs as a simple web application fetching large format PDF files, resizing them to fit the large format display. The result is a display that is both engaging and passive. No UI, nothing to touch, nothing to fiddle with. The newspaper cycle about every ten minutes. In the morning there's always a fresh front page to skim from papers from across the country.
cues.zh: 还有第一修正案权利，也就是新闻自由。报纸部分作为一个简单的 Web 应用运行，抓取大幅面 PDF 文件，调整尺寸以适配大幅面显示屏。最终呈现出的显示既吸引人又被动。没有 UI，没有可触摸的东西，也没有可摆弄的东西。报纸大约每十分钟循环一次。早晨总有一份新鲜的头版，可以浏览来自全国各地的报纸。

cues.en: The beauty is that e ink is 99%
cues.zh: 电子墨水屏的优点是能效比传统

cues.en: more efficient than traditional
cues.zh: LCD 显示屏高 99%。

cues.en: LCD displays. And so this really means that I can hang the device on the wall, and I really don't need to charge it for months at a time. When I do need to charge it up, it has a USB cable. I simply plug it in and top it up to a 100.
cues.zh: 这意味着我可以把设备挂在墙上，连续几个月都不用充电。需要充电时，它有一根 USB 线，插上就能充到 100%。

cues.en: So why did I build this? I saw something similar a few years ago, and I thought it was really cool and really interesting.
cues.zh: 那我为什么要做这个呢？几年前我见过类似的东西，觉得特别酷，也很有意思。

cues.en: If you wanna do something like this yourself, I've left some links to resources in my code in the description below. I worked on a newspaper when I was in college, and my editor in chief, his name was Mike Bosse, and he used to always tell me to read
cues.zh: 如果你也想做一个类似的项目，我在下方简介里留了一些资源和我的代码链接。我上大学时曾在一家报社工作，当时的主编叫 Mike Bosse，他总是告诉我，要多读

cues.en: multiple newspapers. He said the truth is never in one newspaper or another newspaper. Every writer, every story has some bias. And by reading multiple newspapers, you get a better semblance, a better perspective on where the truth really lives. For me, this digital display is a little reminder of that. What we may see in one paper in Boston or New York or San Francisco may be something that's very different in the state of Texas, Illinois,
cues.zh: 不同的报纸。他说，真相从来不会只存在于某一家报纸上。每个作者、每篇报道都会带有某种偏见。而通过阅读多家报纸，你才能更好地还原全貌，从更好的视角看清真相到底在哪里。对我来说，这个数字屏幕就是对这一点的微小提醒。我们在波士顿、纽约或旧金山的报纸上看到的内容，在得克萨斯州、伊利诺伊州

cues.en: or Arkansas. The other aspect I want to touch on is the design.
cues.zh: 或阿肯色州可能会截然不同。我想谈的另一个方面是设计。

cues.en: Newspapers have a fantastic amount of design that goes into the page.
cues.zh: 报纸的版面设计极为讲究。

cues.en: The balance of the typography,
cues.zh: 排版的平衡感，

cues.en: the fonts, the headlines,
cues.zh: 字体、标题，

cues.en: how images relate to those headlines,
cues.zh: 图片与标题如何呼应，

cues.en: and how you skim the page for the content that's most important.
cues.zh: 以及你如何快速浏览页面，找到最重要的内容。

cues.en: I think a lot of the principles in newspaper design actually apply to many other aspects of the design and user interface that we see all around us in mobile devices and websites
cues.zh: 我认为报纸设计的许多原则，其实也适用于我们身边移动设备和网站中设计与用户界面的许多其他方面，

cues.en: and it's often underappreciated.
cues.zh: 而这往往被人低估。

cues.en: When done well, the headlines are easy to read, the columns are easy to glance, and it's easy to really digest a whole breadth of information
cues.zh: 做好之后，标题清晰易读，栏目一目了然，你也能快速消化大量信息

cues.en: in just a quick glance.
cues.zh: 只需匆匆一瞥。

cues.en: I'm Greg Raiz. I'm an angel investor,
cues.zh: 我是 Greg Raiz，一名天使投资人，

cues.en: entrepreneur. I love talking about entrepreneurship,
cues.zh: 也是一名企业家。我喜欢聊创业、

cues.en: technology, and design. I hope I'll catch you on the next one.
cues.zh: 科技和设计。希望下次节目还能见到你。
